limitations: No complete basin boundary or global dynamics for data outside certified subregions
Results hold for fixed phi and deterministic positive ODE solutions, for all positive epsilon
Extinction comparison is optimal only within the explicit pointwise quadratic/exponential bounding argument; relative entropy barrier is optimal for that sublevel containment criterion
Earlier broad strong-Allee phase-portrait and separatrix results are prior art; historical priority of exact specialized inequalities is not independently established
scientific_integrity: Frozen-parameter continuous ODE; two strictly sufficient parameter-explicit initial-data basin certificates. Distinct from the nonautonomous ramp-rate threshold. Neither test is necessary; no independent audit or field validation.
title: Two explicit, opposing basin certificates in a strong-Allee tipping model
